subject: [PATCH v2 3/5] mm/page_alloc: snapshot the preferred zone against shrink rebuilds

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch modifies the `get_page_from_freelist` function to read the preferred zone only once, rather than at every use. This is done to prevent a kernel NULL pointer dereference that can occur when a concurrent zonelist rebuild replaces or nulls out the preferred slot. The change ensures that even if the preferred slot is replaced, a stale but valid zone will still be used, preventing the dereference error.
